description: MBR-106: stable config, data, cache, and log roots for current macOS installs. `membrane cli doctor paths` prints the same values at runtime so an operator can diff a live install against this template.

data.purpose: persistent memory DB and checkpoints; survives update

cache.purpose: regenerable caches (fastembed artifacts, downloaded models); safe to wipe

log.purpose: append-only logs from resident and Hub; rotates independently of data

receipt.description: tracks every file the runtime writes outside the four stable roots
receipt.uninstallRespects: files outside the four roots are removed only when listed here
